root_mathematical_findings: The rank-three criterion accounts for every subset pair; the relative-index lemma uses noncontainment.
The Sylow p=3 exception is ruled out by the A4 involution image; the inverted orbit proves two generators without claiming inversion is an automorphism of P.
The character projectors give exactly the two needed cyclic components; the product inequality orders their exponents, and the direct model proves full IP.
Cancellation gives successive ideal indices; norm-one unit ratios prove pO=pi^(p-1)O, and lattice containment plus equal index proves the actual coordinate moduli.
The explicit pair law proves both automorphisms, orders, generation and intersection for every stated p,m; no finite sample is used as a quantified proof.
The actual source-generator isomorphism follows from a surjection plus an independent upper bound; conjugation identities and the lower central series recover the auxiliary claims.
